name: mere-orthodoxy
description: Mere Orthodoxy — Christian renewal for the common good.

podcast_feed_url.description: URL of the deployed podcast-feed Worker. Leave empty to hide the podcast section.

content_api_key.description: Ghost Content API key for the homepage topic filter (optional).

membership_api_base.description: Base URL for the membership-site Express app (Stripe + HubSpot endpoints).

audio_worker_url.description: Full URL of the deployed mo-audio Cloudflare Worker (e.g. https://mo-audio.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). When set, paid Members see a 'Listen to this essay' button in the post header. Empty disables audio articles.

kit_worker_url.description: Full URL of the deployed mo-kit Cloudflare Worker (e.g. https://mo-kit.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). When set, signup forms pass topic/source context labels to Ghost, and engagement events (audio plays, article reads, membership clicks) are forwarded to Kit as tags. Empty disables the Kit integration entirely.

gift_worker_url.description: URL of the deployed mo-gift Worker (e.g. https://mo-gift.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). When set, a 4th action button appears on gate-eligible articles for any signed-in member, letting them copy a gift link that bypasses the soft gate for the recipient. Empty hides the button.

forms_worker_url.description: URL of the deployed mo-forms Worker (e.g. https://mo-forms.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). Powers /contact/, /submissions/, /sponsorship/, and /writers-meetings/. Empty disables those forms.

admin_worker_url.description: URL of the deployed mo-admin Worker (e.g. https://mo-admin.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). Powers /admin/ and its sub-pages. Empty disables the admin dashboard's data fetches (page still renders; stats stay blank).

kit_bridge_url.description: URL of the deployed mo-kit-bridge Worker (e.g. https://mo-kit-bridge.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). Powers /admin/drift/ (Ghost↔Kit reconciliation report). Empty disables the drift page.

search_worker_url.description: URL of the deployed mo-search Worker (e.g. https://mo-search.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). Powers semantic search via OpenAI embeddings + Cloudflare Vectorize. Empty disables search (modal still opens but shows a 'not configured' hint).

plausible_domain.description: Plausible site ID (usually the domain — e.g. mereorthodoxy.com). When set, the Plausible tracking script loads site-wide and the KPI dashboard can query stats. Empty disables both. Use the production domain even on staging so stats accumulate in the right account.

error_worker_url.description: URL of the deployed mo-errors Worker (e.g. https://mo-errors.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). When set, the theme posts uncaught errors / unhandled rejections / CSP violations to the worker so Ian can see what's breaking in production. Empty disables the beacon.

referral_offer_url.description: New-member Ghost Offer link for the referral program (e.g. https://mereorthodoxy.com/#/portal/offers/abc123). When a visitor arrives via a /membership/?ref= link, the 'Become a Member' CTA is repointed here so the referred person gets the first-period discount. Empty = referral still works but single-sided (no new-member offer). Create the offer in Ghost Admin → Membership → Offers.

heatmap_sample.description: Percentage of homepage sessions recorded by the click heatmap at /admin/heatmap/. Sampling is decided once per browser tab, so a recorded session is recorded whole. Set to 0 to switch collection off entirely.

bible_worker_url.description: Full URL of the deployed mo-bible Cloudflare Worker (e.g. https://mo-bible.mo-podcast-feed.workers.dev). Powers the Scripture reader and Daily Liturgy passage lookups. Empty disables Scripture display.
